embeds.title: ⚔️  Guild Board 1.3 has landed
embeds.description:
**Lok'tar ogar, Push To Prod.** The addon finally pulls its weight. Hover any item and it tells you who in the guild wants it, ping the crew for dungeons from your minimap, and see every ding and death as it happens.

**[⬇️  Download 1.3 now](https://github.com/KrisHendo09/guild-board/releases/latest)**  then restart WoW

embeds.title: 🙏  Until CurseForge approves us
embeds.description:
**I am once again asking you to manually download and install the update.**
Grab it from the link above, unzip it into your AddOns folder, and restart WoW. Once CurseForge approves the project, the CurseForge app will keep it updated for you.

footer: Something busted? Type /gb bug in game  ·  CurseForge auto updates coming soon  ·  For the Horde
